meta.title: Animal Hospital rooms and camera zones data

sources.label: YouTube - Animal Hospital - FULL GAME + ALL ANOMALIES | Roblox

items.name: Heart Monitor Room
items.objective: Check the patient's heart on the monitor sequence.
items.anomalyRisk: Normal treatment can stall the run if the patient check is ignored or left incomplete.
items.warningSigns: The room shows a heart-monitor screen and a patient-check sequence.
items.safeAction: Stay on the heart-monitor prompt until the patient check completes before moving to the next room.
items.failConsequence: Patient-care failure or blocked shift progress.
items.cardSummary: The Heart Monitor Room starts the Shift 3 treatment chain. It matters because the player has to finish the monitor check before the later treatment rooms make sense.
items.verificationNote: Video description names Heart Monitor Room at 04:38; storyboard frames around the timestamp show the heart-monitor room and monitor minigame.
items.imageStatus: No clean production image; YouTube storyboard crop is low-resolution and UI-covered.

items.name: X-Ray Room
items.objective: Move the patient through the X-ray step after the heart-monitor check.
items.anomalyRisk: Skipping the scan step can leave the treatment sequence unresolved.
items.warningSigns: The chapter begins at the X-Ray Room door after the monitor check.
items.safeAction: Enter the X-Ray Room when prompted and finish the scan step before continuing.
items.cardSummary: The X-Ray Room is the middle treatment stop in Shift 3. It is useful as a route marker because it comes after the heart monitor and before surgery.
items.verificationNote: Video description names X-Ray Room at 05:10; storyboard frames around 05:10 show the room door and the next medical-station sequence.
items.imageStatus: No clean production image; available storyboard evidence is too compressed for a catalog card.

items.name: Surgery Room
items.objective: Treat the patient on the surgery table during the final Shift 3 room step.
items.anomalyRisk: The patient is exposed on the surgery table, so leaving the sequence unfinished risks a failed treatment chain.
items.warningSigns: The room has an operating table, medical lights, and a patient lying on the table.
items.safeAction: Complete the surgery-room treatment prompt before returning to normal shift movement.
items.failConsequence: Patient-care failure or blocked shift progress.
items.cardSummary: The Surgery Room closes the main Shift 3 treatment route. It is the most obvious room to remember because the patient is already on the operating table.
items.verificationNote: Video description names Surgery Room at 05:51; storyboard frames around the timestamp show the patient on an operating table.
items.imageStatus: No clean production image; available storyboard evidence has UI and YouTube compression.

items.name: Camera 1
items.objective: Check a monitored hospital zone for an anomaly instead of walking into the room first.
items.anomalyRisk: Camera-feed anomalies can raise the hospital incident count if they are ignored.
items.warningSigns: The CCTV-style view shows the monitored zone with a shift report and incident count nearby.
items.safeAction: Use the camera interface to inspect the feed and respond to the anomaly prompt before leaving it unresolved.
items.failConsequence: Hospital death or anomaly count can increase.
items.cardSummary: Camera 1 is a monitored zone rather than a normal room. It matters because the player has to read the feed and react from the camera interface.
items.verificationNote: All-anomalies source names Camera 1 at 00:00; storyboard frames show CCTV-style hospital feeds and shift-report incident tracking.
items.imageStatus: No clean production image; storyboard frames are low-resolution and UI-heavy.

items.name: Camera 2
items.objective: Check a second monitored hospital zone for a separate camera anomaly.
items.anomalyRisk: A second camera feed can carry a different anomaly check from Camera 1.
items.warningSigns: The camera interface stays active while the feed changes to another hospital view.
items.safeAction: Inspect the second feed separately and use the emergency or interaction prompt if the anomaly appears.
items.failConsequence: Hospital death or anomaly count can increase.
items.cardSummary: Camera 2 should stay separate from Camera 1 because it appears as its own camera anomaly check. Treat it as a second monitored zone until later gameplay proves the feeds share the same room.
items.verificationNote: All-anomalies source names Camera 2 at 00:38; full-game source also has a Camera Anomalies chapter at 08:11.
items.imageStatus: No clean production image; storyboard frames are low-resolution and UI-heavy.
